name: Nawi · Nahuel Mosse

wordmark.style: normal, uppercase, weight 700, no variable axes
wordmark.minimumSize: 3rem on the phone, 15vw at the scale of a poster word

fontRoles.Boska: posters: NAWI, chapter words, project words and numerals; never below 3rem
fontRoles.General Sans: all running text, buttons and navigation, 16px or more
fontRoles.Courier Prime: short uppercase labels of the file only (ten characters or so)

rules.ground: ink or a product color; bone only as type and as the lit edge of a drawing
rules.accent: crimson is the only accent outside a project; inside a project the product color replaces it
rules.illustration: screen-printed noir, three flat inks (ink, bone, one spot color), see design/art-direction.md

icon: the word NAWI in Boska; clear space equal to the cap height
voice: First person, short: 'I build it, I ship it.'
Concrete: names the product, the problem and his role, never a figure
Dry: no exclamation marks, no adjectives that sell
